newsitem.title: UK: UK Channel 5 says on target for March 30 launch.
newsitem.headline: UK Channel 5 says on target for March 30 launch.

text.p: Britain's Channel 5 said on Wednesday that its video retuners had visited more than five million households and that it was on target to meet its March 30 launch date.
"We have to have checked 9.7 million homes by the time we launch and we're over 50 percent of the way there," Channel 5 spokeswoman Sally Osman told Reuters.
The new terrestrial channel has employed an army of retuners who are visiting homes across Britain adjusting video recorders to prevent interference from its signal.
The bill for the retuning operation has almost trebled to 150 million stg after Channel 5 was awarded a new frequency which boosted its coverage to 80 percent of the UK.
Osman said retuners had been visiting almost half a million households per week in the run-up to Christmas. She added that the London area would be the last to be retuned.

Channel 5, a consortium comprising Pearson, United News & Media, CLT of Luxembourg and U.S. investment firm Warburg Pincus, earlier announced it had secured live rights to the Poland-England World Cup soccer tie on May 31.
Channel 5 will also screen the Argentina versus England rugby union international live on the same day as part of a sporting double-bill.
